subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The visit showed that future food may come from many systems.”?
options: Maggie's old uniform had become different because it carried her own memories.
Fields, greenhouses, rooftops, and warehouses may all become part of feeding cities.
A sculpture may stand silently, but the conversations around it can become part of its purpose.
Feeding an animal is easy, but helping it go home is better.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The visit showed that future food may come from many systems. Fields, greenhouses, rooftops, and warehouses may all become part of feeding cities.」，答案為「Fields, greenhouses, rooftops, and warehouses may all become part of feeding cities.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Fields, greenhouses, rooftops, and warehouses may all become part of feeding cities.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
